steps.title: Prepare 0.2 mol/L NaOH Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10 mL solution of 0.2 mol/L NaOH (sodium hydroxide).

substeps.instruction: Label a new 15 ml falcon tube as 'NaOH 0.2 mol/L'.
Add 10 mL DNA-free water and 0.080 g of NaOH to the tube.
Mix manually or using a vortex to dissolve.

steps.title: Extract DNA from Meat Sample
steps.instruction: Process fresh pork meat to release DNA using NaOH.

substeps.instruction: Place 0.5 g of fresh pork meat (without fat) in a pestle and mortar.
Add 4 mL of the prepared 0.2 mol/L NaOH.
Triturate (grind) the mix until it becomes a paste/liquid.
Optionally filter the resulting mixture using a syringe and Luer filter.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Heating
steps.instruction: Aliquot the meat extract into a PCR tube.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 5 μL from the meat mix into a new sterile 100 μl PCR tube labeled 'prepared sample' using a 1-10 μl pipette (preferably with filtered tips).

steps.title: Lysis and Heating
steps.instruction: Heat the sample to break down cellular structures.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μL of 0.2 mol/L NaOH to the 'prepared sample' tube.
Heat the resulting 45 μL mix at 75 Celsius for 20 minutes using a water bath, LAMP, or PCR device.

steps.title: Neutralize and Store Sample
steps.instruction: Neutralize the pH of the sample and prepare for storage.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the contents of the 'prepared sample' tube to a new 1.5 ml centrifuge tube labeled 'final prepared sample'.
Add 360 μl of 0.04 mol/L Tris HCl (pH 7.75) to neutralize the pH.
Before freezing at -20, aliquot 1 μl of the sample and measure the result using a NanoDrop or equivalent device (expected yield is approximately 100 ng of DNA).
